ufbx - vendored source
======================

Upstream:  https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx
Version:   v0.22.0
Commit:    ee203dfe62d60c98227288f6d74b9a117857c065
License:   MIT OR Unlicense - see LICENSE (3D Review elects MIT)

What is vendored
----------------
`ufbx.h` and `ufbx.c` from the tag above, unmodified (byte-identical apart from
line endings), plus upstream's `LICENSE`. `crates/import/build.rs` compiles
them together with the project's own C bridge when both files are present.

Refreshing: copy the newer upstream pair and LICENSE in, update the version and
commit above, and re-run the workspace tests - `crates/import`'s fixture suite
and `crates/optimize`'s export round-trips both read FBX through this copy.
